points.point: A reasonable probability of damage triggers severe-service requirements without waiting for confirmed damage.
The employer must stop using the equipment.
A qualified person must perform the required inspection.
The inspection checks for structural damage to determine whether continued use can be safe.

answer.sample_answer: The reasonable probability of damage meets the severe-service threshold, so the employer must stop using the crane without waiting for confirmed damage. A qualified person must inspect for structural damage to determine whether the crane can continue to be used safely.
misconceptions: Visible or confirmed damage is required before stopping use.
Reducing load weight permits continued use while awaiting inspection.
Any crew member may perform the inspection solely because of job title.
The inspection is intended only to document damage, without evaluating safe continued use.

quotes.quote: Where the severity of use/conditions is such that there is a reasonable probability of damage or excessive wear
the employer must stop using the equipment and a qualified person must:
Inspect the equipment for structural damage to determine if the equipment can continue to be used safely.

stem: A crane is stopped for severe service after prolonged exposure to a corrosive atmosphere. Explain why completing the structural inspection alone does not finish the required evaluation, what must happen if additional items need inspection, and what follows if a deficiency is found.

points.point: The qualified person must use the exposure conditions to determine whether paragraph (f) items or conditions need inspection.
The qualified person must perform inspections identified as necessary.
If a deficiency is found, the employer must follow paragraphs (f)(4) through (6).

answer.sample_answer: The qualified person must also consider the corrosive exposure and determine whether any paragraph (f) items or conditions need inspection. If any do, the qualified person must inspect those items or conditions. If a deficiency is found, the employer must follow paragraphs (f)(4) through (6).
misconceptions: Finding no structural damage eliminates the separate evaluation of paragraph (f) items.
Recording the need for an inspection satisfies the duty to perform it.
The crew may choose whether to perform inspections already determined necessary.
The supplied text describes the specific corrective actions contained in paragraphs (f)(4) through (6).

quotes.quote: prolonged exposure to a corrosive atmosphere
In light of the use/conditions determine whether any items/conditions listed in paragraph (f) of this section need to be inspected;
if so, the qualified person must inspect those items/conditions.
If a deficiency is found, the employer must follow the requirements in paragraphs (f)(4) through (6) of this section.
